en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Muhammad Bin Al Fuzayl, from Musa Bin Bakr who said,
‘Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘A person will not be in poverty (while observing) moderation’.
en.sarwar: 9. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah from Muhammad ibn Ali from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl from Musa ibn Bakr who has said the following: “
Abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, once said, ‘With moderation, one does not suffer poverty.’”
